{{Top|leg}}
The '''Redbird''' was awarded to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] personnel who were injured in the line of duty. One of the awards given to members of all branches of the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]], it was a small red pin shaped like the [[Alliance Starbird]]. Members of the Alliance [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForces]] were often injured enough to have rows of Redbirds.
